title: Russell Fry Backs Darline Graham in South Carolina Senate Runoff Amid Trump Pressure
summary: The president has been focused on the race since the death of Lindsey Graham in July. Ms. Graham, the late senator’s sister, is competing against Representative Ralph Norman in a runoff on Aug. 25.
